page.title: Card step for Dried cherries, 8 oz

product.name: Dried cherries, 8 oz
product.description: The cherries are dried whole with no sugar stirred in.

blocks.text: The amount to be billed is $52.70.
No packing line is added. Cork grip at eight dollars and eighty eight cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Sales tax is collected where the state requires it.
The tag on Dried cherries, 8 oz was thirty one dollars and twenty one cents.

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $52.70 and the tag was thirty one dollars and twenty one cents. Refuse the higher figure.
